question: Which celebrated filmmaker, noted for globally acclaimed works like Bandit Queen and Elizabeth, received the Padma Bhushan in​2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shekhar Kapur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shekhar Kapur** is a legendary Indian filmmaker and actor who was conferred the **Padma Bhushan** in the field of **Art** for the year **2025** by the Government of India.
 
• He achieved massive international fame with the **1994** biographical film **Bandit Queen**, which depicted the life of **Phoolan Devi** and won the **National Film Award** for Best Feature Film in Hindi.
 
• In the global arena, he is best known for directing the **1998** period drama **Elizabeth**, which garnered seven **Academy Award** nominations and won the **BAFTA Award for Best British Film**.
 
• His contribution to **Bollywood** includes iconic movies such as the sci-fi superhero film **Mr. India** (1987) and the family drama **Masoom** (1983), both considered cult classics in Indian cinema.
 
• He has also served in significant administrative roles, such as the **President of the Film and Television Institute of India (FTII)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Awards**: These are the highest civilian honors in India, announced annually on the eve of **Republic Day**. The **Padma Bhushan** is the third-highest award in this hierarchy, followed by the **Padma Vibhushan**.
 
• Other Notable Nominees/Options:
 
 
• **Mira Nair**: An Indo-American filmmaker famous for **Salaam Bombay!** (nominated for an Oscar) and **Monsoon Wedding**. She received the **Padma Bhushan** earlier in **2012**.
 
• **Deepa Mehta**: An Indo-Canadian director known for her **Elements Trilogy** consisting of **Fire** (1996), **Earth** (1998), and **Water** (2005).
 
• **R Balki**: A contemporary filmmaker and former advertising professional known for directing socially relevant films like **Paa**, **Pad Man**, and **Cheeni Kum**.
